Chapter 1064: 13 Chaos Tree (Requesting Monthly Tickets)

Chapter 1064: Chapter 13 Chaos Tree (Requesting Monthly Tickets)

‘Tear of the Star,’ the ‘Fragmented World.’

His incarnation returned, and Lin Yuan’s true self was brimming with joy.

This journey to the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion had essentially completed its mission.

The dissemination of various branches of the Martial Tao Evolution Road finally had a solid channel.

With the power of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, it was foreseeable that the branches of the Martial Tao Evolution Road would quickly spread to one Void Domain after another.

The speed and breadth of this dissemination would far exceed that within the internal universe.

“The number of branches opened by the Martial Tao Evolution Road… it’s probably enough to startle that Eye of Myriad Laws.”

Lin Yuan mused to himself. The Martial Tao Evolution Road was a path he had forged through his journeys across dimensions of varying levels and realities.

Its elucidation and encapsulation of the essence of power and laws far surpassed other evolutionary paths within the same tier.

This was the reason why even though the Martial Tao Evolution Road was merely of the Path Splitting Realm, it had managed to develop so many branching paths.

To traverse different dimensions and realities was a feat that even beings of the Thirteenth Tier might not achieve. Even great temporal beings were only in the exploratory stages regarding other dimensions.

But Lin Yuan, thanks to the Myriad Realms Gate, could easily travel between dimensions and realities. This was the critical factor in his ability to pioneer the Martial Tao Evolution Road.

“However, that Gate of Myriad Laws truly does seem to be connected to the Thirteenth Tier…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Earlier, during his discussion with the Eye of Myriad Laws,

Lin Yuan had also subtly observed the other party.

Although its presence was by no means comparable to the grand projection of the Myriad Realms Gate, it still stood far above ordinary Chaos Great Saints.

“Unfortunately, to me, its level is still too high to glean much benefit.”

Lin Yuan felt a tinge of regret. If the one conversing with him had been the true body of the Eye of Myriad Laws instead of its projection, he might have gained more insight to assist on his path.

But with only a projection present and such a vast gap in levels between them, Lin Yuan had not gleaned much.

“Hmm?”

“My incarnation has successfully arrived at the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain?”

Lin Yuan’s heart stirred slightly as he gazed in that direction.

Back when he first explored the Chaos Void, he had acquired numerous treasures left behind by the peak Sovereign Realm powerhouse ‘Cang Weiyang.’ Those treasures were effectively Lin Yuan’s “first pot of gold.”

‘Cang Weiyang’ had not made any demands of Lin Yuan, only hoping that, if he had the chance in the future, Lin Yuan would visit the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain and accept a member of the Stone People Clan as his disciple.

With Lin Yuan’s current strength, this task was relatively straightforward, so he had sent an incarnation ahead of time to the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain.

…

The Myriad Manifestations Void Domain.

Chaos Qi swirled, coalescing into a figure—it was Lin Yuan.

“I’ve finally arrived.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The Myriad Manifestations Void Domain was not particularly far from the Void Domain where the Ancient Ming Continent was located.

They were adjacent Void Domains.

Even so, it had taken Lin Yuan nearly ten years to travel from his starting point to his destination.

It was worth noting that Lin Yuan’s comprehension of time and space had already reached the Eighth Realm, and his travel speed was on par with that of a Chaos Venerable.

Many newly ascended Chaos Venerables had yet to reach the Eighth Realm in their comprehension of time and space and were even slower to traverse.

“No wonder they say that even Chaos Great Saints and Supreme Great Saints could hardly travel every corner of the Chaos Void.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, a faint sense of awe coloring his thoughts.

The scale of the Chaos Void was truly incomprehensible.

“The Stone People Clan…”

Lin Yuan glanced around and confirmed the direction.

The intelligence passed down by ‘Cang Weiyang’ naturally included detailed information on the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain and the Stone People Clan.

The Chaos Void, which birthed countless universes, also gave rise to innumerable groups of sentient life.

These life forms, whether strong or weak, found their place. The Stone People Clan, for instance, was one of the weaker groups and resided in a secluded secret realm.

A “secret realm” was a concealed space naturally generated within the Chaos Void. In terms of safety, it certainly could not compare to being within a universe.

But for the Stone People Clan, it was already an excellent sanctuary—at least their entire group could thrive in peaceful seclusion there.

Of course, such a “secret realm” also meant an extreme scarcity of cultivation resources, which was why ‘Cang Weiyang’ had ventured out of the secret realm in pursuit of his own journey.

A lone secret realm could never nurture a pinnacle Sovereign Realm powerhouse.

Whoosh.

Soon enough,

Lin Yuan arrived before the Stone People Clan’s secret realm.

This secret realm, hidden deep within layers of time and space, was incredibly difficult to detect.

However, with Lin Yuan’s comprehension of time and space, it posed no problem—especially with the precise coordinates left behind by ‘Cang Weiyang.’

Rustle.

Lin Yuan stepped forward and entered the secret realm directly.

The barriers and obstructions outside the secret realm were like thin paper to Lin Yuan—easy to break through.

“Quick and efficient.”

Lin Yuan planned to randomly choose a member of the Stone People Clan, accept them as a disciple, and bring them back to human civilization.

As for how strong this disciple could eventually become, it would depend on their own fortune.

“Hmm?”

Floating in the air, Lin Yuan gazed down at the secret realm.

The secret realm inhabited by the Stone People Clan spanned several hundred light-years—”narrow” by all accounts—and Lin Yuan could see through it at a glance.

This was entirely expected. The Stone People Clan was not a powerful group; its strongest individuals were at the Path Splitting Realm, so the realm they occupied could not be particularly favorable.

If it had been a vast and exceptional secret realm, how could the Stone People Clan have claimed it?

“Not a single member of the Stone People Clan…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze swept the secret realm, finding it desolate. In some areas, there were even deep craters, giving a sense of ruin.

“According to the intelligence left by Senior ‘Cang Weiyang,’ the population of the Stone People Clan numbered over a trillion, though most only had strength at the Fourth and Fifth Ranks…”

Lin Yuan furrowed his brows slightly. “Why is there not a single one left now?”
